svg.text: DETENTION UNDER THE MENTAL HEALTH ACT, 2012 (ACT 846)
Every power to detain comes tied to a time limit and to somebody who reviews it.

g.text: Admitted on her own request.
May ask to leave in writing at any time.
The request must be granted within
TWENTY-FOUR HOURS.
Detaining a voluntary patient by simply

svg.text: not opening the door is unlawful.

g.text: Requires a court order and TWO
independent recommendations.
The order lasts up to ONE MONTH.
Prolonged detention up to twelve
months, reviewed at six.
Monthly review by the head of facility (s.45).
The emergency route: detention for up to SEVENTY-TWO HOURS while proper assessment is arranged.
Safe custody somewhere other than a mental health facility must not exceed FORTY-EIGHT HOURS.
The patient, her relative or anyone acting
for her may appeal against detention.
Telling her so is part of admitting her.
Only for imminent danger, only when
less restrictive measures have failed,
authorised by the head or senior nurse.
Capacity is presumed (s.97), children are kept separate from adults (s.65),
and attempted suicide ceased to be a criminal offence in Ghana in 2023. Bring her to care, not to a police station.
